issues.message: Headline is clipped at the right canvas edge — reads 'BUY ETFs COMMI' with the remainder of the word (likely 'COMMISSION FREE') cut off. Text overflows the 300px canvas.
CTA label is clipped — reads 'START INV' with the remainder of the word (likely 'INVESTING' or 'INVEST NOW') cut off by the right canvas edge. The pill itself also extends past the canvas boundary.
Because both the headline and CTA are truncated, the intended reading hierarchy collapses — viewers cannot complete the value proposition or the action prompt.
Variant is a near-pixel match to the source, which itself appears to exhibit the same clipping at 300x250. The defect is faithfully reproduced rather than introduced.

notes: Variant mirrors the source almost exactly, but inherits critical text-clipping defects on both the headline and CTA at this 300x250 format. Not shippable as-is.
